rationale: The discourse has clarified the competing positions and even added expert validation that a no-closure path is possible in principle, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour/state insist on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management/owners/investors still refuse to rule out hard restructuring. The repeated exchange is now circling around the same abstractions, so the next useful step is intervention with a concrete quantitative model rather than another round of principle statements.
